title: n8n Business Automation - Part 1
description: Business automation with n8n covering workflow design, nodes, triggers, webhooks, HTTP requests, expressions, database workflows, and AI automation. This submodule covers: Automation fundamentals, n8n interface, Workflows, Nodes, Triggers, Webhooks.
learning_outcomes: Design and build automation workflows in n8n
Use various nodes for data processing and transformation
Create triggers from webhooks, schedules, and events
